apod.explanation: Don't judge a galaxy by its size. This Hubble image shows NGC 4449, a dwarf galaxy about a tenth the size of the Milky Way — yet dwarf galaxies are the most common type in the universe. NGC 4449 and similar dwarfs are missing more oxygen than models predict, suggesting their stellar winds and supernovae are surprisingly effective at blowing away oxygen and other heavy elements. These tiny galaxies may play a big role in spreading the building blocks of stars, planets and life throughout the universe.
apod.title: NGC 4449: Small Galaxy, Big Impact

breaking.fact: The S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7,619.38 and the Nasdaq 1.60% to 25,466.19 on Wednesday, with the Dow up 0.49% to 52,486.49. CoreWeave jumped 24.71% after raising its 2026 revenue outlook, Nvidia rebounded 2.9% after a two-day slide, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 5.66%. The bond market was closed for Veterans Day.
breaking.headline: Stocks rebound as CoreWeave's 25% surge revives the AI trade

breaking.fact: Nvidia has named a former federal prosecutor to lead its board probe of CEO Jensen Huang over the Chinese spy scandal, shareholders have sued Nvidia and Huang, and a Senate Republican has urged Huang to resign. Nvidia shares still rose 2.9% Wednesday to $173.73.
breaking.headline: Nvidia names former federal prosecutor to lead Huang probe as shareholders sue

breaking.fact: The national average gas price fell to $3.98 a gallon on Nov 10, the first time under $4 since July, even as households still face higher food, housing and energy costs and the Fed weighs a December rate hike.
breaking.headline: Gasoline falls below $4 a gallon nationally for first time since July

breaking.fact: Negotiators from the US, Russia and Ukraine began a second day of talks in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday, amid European fears over territorial concessions. No breakthrough has been reported so far.
breaking.headline: US, Russia and Ukraine open second day of Abu Dhabi talks

items.body: A Saudi-flagged tanker, NCC FAJR, was involved in a possible attack while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, India's shipping minister said; all crew including three Indian seafarers are safe. It is the second incident in under 24 hours: on Tuesday the Liberia-flagged VLCC MT FUJAIRAH ENERGY was hit by a projectile in the Persian Gulf, injuring four crew.
items.headline: Saudi-flagged tanker in possible Hormuz attack; crew safe

items.body: Iran unveiled a new underground missile base on Tuesday and said three tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the strait — claims US Central Command called false. Confirmed separately: UKMTO reported a projectile strike on a tanker northeast of Oman's Lima on Tuesday, and ADNOC confirmed one of its vessels was damaged in UAE waters. November attacks already total at least 10, after 37 in October.
items.headline: Iran shows off underground missile city; mine claims disputed

hormuz.stats: Traffic & shares (latest verified): AIS-visible commercial traffic is running about 8% of normal — 6.9 ships a day over the past week (18 tankers) against 84.8 before the crisis. EIA puts Hormuz oil flows at 4.9M bbl/day in Q2 2026, down from 21.6M in Q4 2025; the IEA estimates ~20M bbl/day transited in 2025, about a quarter of global seaborne oil trade. China takes ~42% and India ~13% of strait crude throughput; ~90% of Iran's oil exports go to China. The EIA warns vessel-tracking data have become less reliable during the conflict.

marketsNote: Stocks rebound Wednesday after Tuesday's CPI-driven slide: S&P 500 +1.31% to 7,619.38, Nasdaq +1.60% to 25,466.19, Dow +0.49% to 52,486.49 as CoreWeave (+25%) and Nvidia (+2.9%) revive the AI trade and chip stocks jump — the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index +5.66%. Oil edges up (WTI $86.47, Brent $92.64) as Hormuz attacks keep a risk premium in crude; the VIX falls to 17.49. The bond market was closed for Veterans Day, so the 10-year yield is Tuesday's 4.98%.

space.body: SpaceX is targeting Friday, Nov 13 for Starship Flight 15 from Starbase, Texas — the first attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Ship upper stage at the tower — and Florida Today reports it could be the last Texas flight before a debut from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39A, where preparations are well advanced. The 75-minute window opens 4:45 p.m. CT Friday, pending FAA sign-off on the license change for the ship catch.
space.headline: Starship's Friday launch in Texas could be its last before a Florida debut

space.body: Astronomers report in Science Advances a hidden object tugging on a red giant in the Pisces constellation, J0008+0128 — most likely a neutron star weighing about 2.2 solar masses, well above the typical 1.4, found in data from China's LAMOST telescope, APOGEE and ESA's Gaia. Where the extra mass came from is an open question that could shed light on the extreme physics inside neutron stars.
space.headline: Invisible object in a distant binary may be a rare supermassive neutron star

space.body: Researchers at Radboud University and Durham University report in Nature Chemistry that a simple biodegradable polymer bubble can move away from lactic acid on its own, with no motor — a step toward artificial cells with lifelike behavior and, in the long term, self-steering particles for targeted drug delivery.
space.headline: Biodegradable bubble steers itself away from lactic acid — a step toward artificial cells

weekInBrief.body: Anthropic filed Tuesday for a Nasdaq listing, planning to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each — raising up to $64.35 billion and implying a $1.404 trillion valuation at the top of the range, below the $2 trillion reportedly targeted a couple of months ago. The Google-backed maker of the Claude chatbot also launched office tools aimed at finance work.
weekInBrief.headline: Anthropic files for a $1.4 trillion Nasdaq IPO

weekInBrief.body: In its November 10 Short-Term Energy Outlook, the EIA said Brent crude averaged $124 a barrel in October — the highest monthly average since July 2022 after adjusting for inflation — as attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz kept a risk premium in crude even as prices eased from their peaks.
weekInBrief.headline: EIA: Brent averaged $124 a barrel in October

weekInBrief.body: The FDA announced Nov 10 it is adding a rare vision-loss warning to GLP-1 drug labels — the class behind Lilly's Mounjaro and Zepbound and Novo Nordisk's Ozempic — after reports of a rare eye condition in patients taking the drugs.
weekInBrief.headline: FDA adds rare vision-loss warning to GLP-1 labels

weekInBrief.body: The administration's USDA proposed tightening SNAP eligibility, which Reuters reports would cut food stamps for 6.3 million people. The same announcement released a second $10 billion installment of rural health funds to all 50 states.
weekInBrief.headline: USDA proposes tighter SNAP rules affecting 6.3 million people
